eROSITA-DE:DataRelease1:HalfSkyMaps_DR1 eRASS1 Half sky maps This website offers broad and narrow band maps for visualising the eROSITA-DE X-ray data. We also offer HiPS maps. ID Name Link to map Description Reference Broad band maps 1 eRASS1 0.200 – 0.400 keV map 0.200 – 0.400 keV map 0.200 – 0.400 keV band image of the eRASS1 data (TM8 1 ), shown in Galactic coordinates, 
                    using the Aitoff projection. The map was created with the "withweights=NO” option, therefore it reports the count rate collected by TM1, TM2, TM3, TM4, 
                    and TM6, with no renormalisation to TM0 (the latter being the standard choice in the eSASS command). The pixel size is 3' x 3'. The pixels show surface 
                    brightness values in units of cts/s/pxl, equivalent to cts/s/(9arcmin^2), with counts collected within the band. See the reference for further details on 
                    the image production. Zheng, X., et al., A&A, 681, A77 (2024) 2 eRASS1 0.400 – 0.600 keV map 0.400 – 0.600 keV map 0.400 – 0.600 keV band image of the eRASS1 data (TM8 1 ), shown in Galactic coordinates,
